_readme.how_it_works: The app downloads THIS file at startup. Edit it here on GitHub and the app picks it up - no rebuild, no update needed.
_readme.ad_network: admob = show ads | none = turn ALL ads off everywhere.
_readme.ad_ids: Your AdMob unit ids. Replace the test ids with your real ones to earn money.
_readme.app_open.on_launch: true/false - full-screen ad when the app is opened cold.
_readme.app_open.on_return: true/false - ad when returning from background.
_readme.game.*_interstitial: "interstitial" = ON, "off" = OFF. Full-screen ad at that moment.
_readme.game.*_rewarded: "rewarded" = ON, "off" = OFF. Rewarded video at that moment. Independent of the interstitial switch.
_readme.placements: menu = main-menu buttons | enter_world = entering a world | death = player died/restart | exit_world = save & quit | boss = boss defeated.
_readme.interstitials.cooldown_seconds: Minimum seconds between two INTERSTITIALS only. App-open and rewarded ads do NOT consume this cooldown.
_readme.interstitials.every_n: Show an interstitial only every Nth time one could show. 0 = every time.
_readme.remove_ads_reward.enabled: true = show the floating Remove Ads button (rewarded video grants ad-free minutes).
